means.example-sentence: It was almost a decade ago that I saw this movie for the first time with my father.
means.sentence-jp: 私が父と初めてこの映画を見たのは10年近く前のことだった。

cloze.maskedText: It was almost a decade ago that I saw this movie ____ with my father.

notes: for the first time in 10 years は『10年ぶりに』の意味。(直訳は『10年で初めて』。)
『2度目に』なら for the second time。for the last time は『最後に』。
